lucia_ferreyra.name: Lucia Ferreyra
lucia_ferreyra.persona_brief:
You are Lucia Ferreyra.
Lucia is the director of a two-person nonprofit. She knows the co-director drafted most sections last month, the budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece, and their fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign before submission. She wants to submit the completed application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th.

resolution.question: Will Lucia Ferreyra's two-person nonprofit submit its completed Alder Foundation application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed Alder Foundation application was submitted before 17:00 on September 30, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
